translation.name: Nasoruan siGot len nasoruan ta Uluveu

content: AYesu igol navǝlan nǝvanuan imaur
Len nǝboŋ sua tile am, aYesu eb̃is lohoim nab̃onb̃onan seJu gail tǝtas, ale ikad avan sual ei, navǝlan tomat, togǝm hum towas.
Nǝvanuan gail ei lomǝtan aYesu hǝn ke lǝb̃eris b̃igol atenan b̃imaur len nǝSappat. B̃igole, dereh likot hǝni ale kel uri ke tob̃ur kotov nalo hǝn nǝSappat.
AYesu ikel mai atenan navǝlan tomat, togǝm hum towas ke, “Geil rivuh.”
Beti eus galit ke, “Inor hǝn datb̃igol b̃ivoi len nǝSappat o hǝn datb̃igol b̃isa? Inor hǝn datb̃eriŋ tǝlmam hǝn nǝmauran o hǝn datb̃igol nǝmatan?” Be naut eb̃ut, lǝsasor vari.
Len nǝlol paŋpaŋ san ekǝta mǝtaltal hǝn galito, ilolosa hǝn galit husur nǝkadulit iṽonṽon. Beti ikel mai atenan ke, “Gisar hǝn navǝlam̃!” Ale isar hǝni, navǝlan imaur tǝlmam.
Vǝha-sua ŋai naFarisi gail lovivile, lub̃onb̃on mai alat galevis len nǝpati tovi tarhǝt siHerot hǝn lǝb̃isor utaut hǝn lǝb̃emǝdas bun aYesu hǝn b̃imat.
Naluṽoh tarhǝb̃iltiwai Kalili
AYesu mai ahai susur san gail lovi lan nab̃iltiwai ale nab̃iltiluṽoh lohusuri. Nǝboŋ lotosǝsǝloŋ husur natit p̃isi aYesu togole, nǝvanuan isob̃ur logǝm hǝni. Logǝm len naut a Kalili, a Jutea,
a Jerusalem, a Itumea, len naut gail tarhǝt Nawisel Jortan mai naut gail lotodar vis nab̃iltivile eru, a Tair mai a Siton.
Bathut naluṽoh totibau, ikel mai ahai susur san gail ke leutaut hǝn nab̃ot viri hǝn asike nǝvanuan lǝb̃eluṽoh dar visi.
Husur len nǝmariboŋ enan igol isob̃ur lumaur tia ale isob̃ur am lotokad namǝsahan tiltile loririhit, dar visi hǝn lǝb̃ibari.
Ale nǝboŋ nǝvanuan lotokad nanunun tosa gail lotoris aYesu, luteh len nǝhon, lukai habat ke, “Gaiug govi aNatun aGot!”
Avil aYesu ikai tas galito ke salikel vǝhot gai ke tovi ase.
AYesu itabtabuh len ahai pispisul lotovi 12
Beti aYesu etǝṽehuh vi mǝhat, ekis alat gai tolǝŋon galito ale logǝm hǝni.
Ale itabtabuh len galit lotovi 12 hǝn lǝb̃itah maii; ekis galit hǝn ahai pispisul gail hǝn b̃esǝvat galit van hǝn lǝb̃ikel ur napisulan siGot;
ale ilav nǝdaŋan hǝn na-il-a-m̃o-an mai galito hǝn lǝb̃ehut natǝmat gail.
Alat lotovi 12 nahǝsalit lumaiegai: ikad aSimon aYesu tokisi hǝn aPita;
ikad aJemes anatun aSepeti mai aJon aṽan aJemes, ale aYesu ekis gǝlaru Poanerkes namilen Natun Nab̃iliurur gǝlaru.
Ikad galevis am, aAdru, aFilip, aPartolomiu, aMattiu, aTomas, aJemes anatun aAlfeus, aTatteus, aSimon tovi naSelot
sua,
mai aJutas Iskariot b̃eriŋ aYesu len navǝlan aenemi san gail.
AYesu mai aPeelsepul
AYesu etǝlmam vahim len naim totohtoh lan mai ahai susur san gail. Ale naluṽoh logǝm b̃onb̃on ei van gai mai ahai susur san gail lǝsǝkad namityal ideh hǝn lǝb̃ihan.
Nǝboŋ nǝbathudud siYesu lotosǝsǝloŋ hǝn nakelean husur nǝsa tovisi, luke litah gati husur luke tovinvinu.
Be ahai p̃usan hǝn nalo lotogǝm len naut a Jerusalem, luke, “APeelsepul toil a m̃o hǝn natǝmat gail iwol hǝni. Ehut natǝmat gail len nǝdaŋan seb̃iltitǝmat setǝmat gail.”
Ale aYesu ekis galit gǝmai, isor mai galit len nasoruan kǝta ke, “ASetan elǝboi b̃ehut aSetan mabe?
Nǝvanuan lototoh pipihabǝlan nakiŋ len nǝkantri sua b̃ib̃alkabaŋ, nǝkantri dereh timap̃ulp̃ul.
Nǝbathudud b̃ib̃alkabaŋ, dereh timap̃ulp̃ul.
Len naṽide tomaienan, aSetan tǝb̃al mai gai gabag, alat pipihabǝlan lǝtapǝpehw, gai asike talǝboi tail gǝgat am, nǝdaŋan san tanoŋ.
Nisor kǝta maiegai ke: Avan ideh salǝboi b̃eb̃is lohoim sinabǝhariv todaŋ hǝn b̃itariv kuv natit san gail. Be a m̃o, b̃ibaŋis gat abǝhariv, beti elǝboi b̃itariv kuv natit p̃isi dan naim san.
Nukel nakitinan mai gamit ke, aGot dereh terub̃at nǝsaan ideh dan nǝvanuan gail naut kǝmas lǝb̃isor tas aGot o lǝb̃emǝdas nahǝsan.
Avil avan ideh tosor mǝdas aNunun aGot, asike aGot erub̃at nǝsaan enan dani boŋ ideh. Be nǝsaan enan san, tonor hǝn nǝpanismen, dereh tipat len atenan vi sutuai.”
AYesu ekǝmaienan husur ahai p̃usan hǝn nalo gail luke tokad nanunun tosa.
Nǝbathudud kitin siYesu
Beti aṽan aYesu matmat gail mai anan logǝm tǝban naim aYesu totoh lan. Loil vivile, lopisul van hǝni, kisi gǝmai.
Naluṽoh lobǝtah dar vis aYesu, ale lukel maii ke, “Geris, anam̃ mai aṽam̃ gail lous gaiug vivile.”
AYesu isor var galit ke, “Ase lai tovi anagw? As galit lai lotovi aṽagw gail?”
Ale ekǝta garu len alat lotobǝtah dar visi, ike, “Gamit mǝtovi anagw mai aṽagw gail bogai.
Husur avan ideh togol nǝsa aGot tolǝŋoni, gai evi aṽagw o aṽavinegw o anagw.”

footnotes.text: 3.18 NaSelot evi avan ideh len naluṽoh sua lotomǝtahun alat a Rom, lotoke lǝb̃ib̃al mai galito, hut galit dan naut a Jutea.
3.27 Namilen ke avan ideh salǝboi b̃evǝnah dan navǝlan aSetan, be b̃ibaŋis gat aSetan, elǝboi b̃ehut natǝmat san gail.
